fixes.explanation: That's the reason, baker, and it's the only one the LORD gives. He says, “Strip off her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.” Not too wild, not out of fruit. If a cookie box with a stranger's name on the lid showed up in my bakery, I wouldn't ask how pretty the cookies look. I'd ask whose box it is.
